verdict.rationale: Gitea is explicitly designed and documented as a self-hostable core Git service, deployable on diverse OSes/architectures with minimal dependencies (gitea-docs-9, gitea-docs-10, gitea-docs-13, gitea-docs-23), and this is strongly corroborated by numerous hands-on community reports of running Gitea in production on VPS, Docker, and low-resource hardware (gitea-comm-1, gitea-comm-3, gitea-comm-6, gitea-comm-7, gitea-comm-8, gitea-comm-14, gitea-comm-18). Missing for 10: independent benchmarks on large-scale/enterprise self-hosted deployments and clearer documentation addressing backup/migration pain points raised by users (gitea-comm-16, gitea-comm-20).
